subject: Errors in reading Analyze 7.5 in v1.12

messages.author: db2a70d9b31cb1f7
messages.subject: Errors in reading Analyze 7.5 in v1.12
parts:
Hi Kylie,

I have trouble reading analyze 7.5 files in the 1.12 version of Cardinal.

I am trying to read the files as before. They could be read like this in Cardinal 1.10 but now when I do the same I get different errors for different files:

msset = readAnalyze("Analyze75")

Error in .readAnalyze.MSImageSet(spectra, mz, coord, files, attach.only) : object 'name' not found
OR for another file:
Error in if (length == 0 && all(extent == 0)) return(new("matter_vec")) : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I can read those files with the code above in v1.10 without problems.

Looking forward to get any hint on this.

Best,
Melanie

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: Errors in reading Analyze 7.5 in v1.12
parts:
I appear to have broken that, sorry. I’m traveling now, but I’ll try to push a fix later this week.

The issue is that a helper function is expecting a ‘name’ variable corresponding to the name of the Analyze files, but I neglected to pass it along.

A short-term workaround is to have an appropriate ‘name’ variable in your global environment.

Using your example:

name <- “Analyze75”
msset <- readAnalyze(name)

should work for you.

Sorry about that,
Kylie
